T2: Requests' contribution guide declares a perpetual feature freeze and recommends early feedback.
T3: a lost response doesn't mean the server failed to process it. urllib3 ... excludes POST from its default retry method set.
T4 (hint only): client.get("https://example.com", timeout=(3, 10)) ... I'd preserve current defaults. It never names DEFAULT_RETRIES=0, read=False or the missing default timeout.
T5: you can start today with a shared session factory ... define policy precedence, eligible failures and methods
Y.actionable: yes - it recommends a shared session factory now, a docs improvement as the first contribution, and early feedback with a narrower proposal, pointing to test_urllib3_retries

why: Both are accurate and cover the same traps. Y adds that urllib3 excludes POST by default, points to the existing retry test, and gives a concrete narrower upstream proposal. Neither explains that the defaults are 0 retries and no timeout.
